description: Analyse de l'évolution des falaises crayeuses du Pays de Caux de Fécamp à Saint-Pierre-en-Port entre 1903 et 2008 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Digitalization of the coastline on the chalky cliffs of the Pays de Caux from the analysis of aerial photographs, from Fécamp to Saint-Pierre-en-Port, between 1930 and 2008. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Analysis of the evolution of the chalky cliffs of the Pays de Caux de Fécamp in Saint-Pierre-en-Port between 1903 and 20" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include trait de côte, seine maritime, géoréférencement. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
